story.body: You looked out from the door at the frozen close, the church porch, and the one lit window. You were not in the picture.

title: Stood in the doorway at the frost

participation.context: Spoke the memo from the door, laughed, and stopped.

participation.context: Named as the Mayor whose window was lit. Not seen and not addressed.
participation.name: Sir John Spencer

story.body: You said you had walked the close twice, that a cat's prints were there before yours, and that one window was lit. You tried a line, heard the stopped nose make it grand, laughed, and stopped. Then you went in.

title: Laughed at a line and came in
